description: This file defines Swedish (Sweden) locale settings for the DateJS library, including cultural info, date and time formats, regex patterns for parsing dates, and prototype extensions for Date objects.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Clears the time part from a Date object, setting hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the Date object to the current system time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Date object.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two Date objects are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of a day given its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of a month given its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month of a year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation given its offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset given a timezone name.
